products.name: Team Rocket Returns Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs, no code card. Charmeleon, the secret rare box topper, is not in the packs. TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: EX Collector's Window Tin [Moltres ex]
products.note: Three EX-series packs and the cosmos holo Moltres ex NP 31 (Nov 2005; pkmn.gg np-31 'EX Collector's Window Tins', TCGplayer listing 87567; the three packs are 'Team Rocket Returns through Legend Maker era' in Bulbapedia's search excerpt, which does not give the mix: low-medium), so it opens here as three Team Rocket Returns packs. Tin not simulated. TCGplayer has no listing for the tin: priced from its three packs plus the promo.
